title: Student V0.1 JOB 05 R1 — contradictory QA after served-V4 repair
purpose: Independently attempt to falsify the repaired served-V4 product using the exact pre-repair QA fixture and new QA-owned probes, without changing product behavior.
invariants: The repaired product bytes are read-only; QA may not repair product code.
The canonical QA fixture is frozen byte-for-byte at Git blob c190fc4f04a7cee5731627e4f6276ee08e39d746 and must not be edited.
The old JOB05 harness is historical evidence only because it intentionally encoded the pre-repair expected failure.
The new QA harness must be independently written for post-repair falsification and must not simply invoke the repair worker's new tests as its sole proof.
All learner interactions must use actual served application controls where browser behavior is claimed.
Canonical answer authority may exist only in the QA driver/out-of-band; it must never be injected into learner presentation or DOM.
A QA-only branch must build to the exact repaired artifact identity because no declared product build source is writable.
No sibling Wave 2 branch output is consumed.
Any newly discovered product defect returns HOLD with exact reproducible ownership; QA never expands scope to fix it.
requiredEvidence: Exact ancestry from 7c13d67a76705b4452304c0f6a882504bc7701a7 and exact repaired product anchor bdb66bffefd6738e3cb4004d304159e9d3d048ce.
Frozen fixture Git blob identity rechecked before execution.
Canonical V4 validator executes successfully against the frozen fixture.
Two canonical builds on the QA result head exactly match each other and the repaired artifact bytes/hash.
Independent static check confirms the old qcm-vs-fill classic dispatch and assessmentRole-everywhere Atlas gate are absent/replaced as intended, without accepting static proof as browser proof.
Real served browser path imports the frozen fixture and traverses all eight families through user-visible controls.

At least one deliberately incorrect evaluated response is independently proven scored=false/correct=false as applicable without contaminating the final completion journey; correct responses are then tested from clean state.
Lesson/flashcard completion never becomes correct/incorrect or review/mastery evidence.
Recursive learner-boundary and DOM scans prove hidden scoring fields absent.
Safe local SVG renders and browser makes no unexpected external request.
At least one active/remote SVG mutation is rejected fail-closed with the rejection attributable to media policy rather than only a stale digest.
Reload/resume occurs at more than one position, including after a non-scored unit and after a scored unit.
Desktop 1365x768 and mobile 390x844 both complete the critical journey.
Keyboard/accessibility smoke covers non-drag controls for matching/order/classify and form labels/status/focus.
V2/V3, R3 and served-V4 repair regression suites remain green.
Minimum exact-head CI route executes the independent QA harness and prior repair regressions.
Qualification evidence separates RESULT_SHA from EVIDENCE_HEAD and records all workflow IDs, artifact hashes, changed paths and rollback.
adversarialTests: A PASS based only on apps/learnit-next/tests/browser_student_v01_served_v4_integration.py is invalid; the QA harness must independently drive the product.
Changing the frozen fixture to fit the repair is a scope failure.
Changing product source or source_manifest.json is a scope failure.
Skipping canonical V4 validation because the fixture passed static inspection is a failure.
Treating blocked/not-run checks as PASS is forbidden.
Treating the canonical local JSON file itself as secret is an invalid claim; the secret boundary is runtime/presentation/DOM.
A desktop-only or happy-path-only journey cannot qualify PASS.
Unexpected HTTP(S) requests, page errors, console errors tied to the journey, or silent unsupported-family fallback are failures.
If the old blocker still reproduces, return HOLD_PRODUCT_GAP rather than rewriting QA expectations.
independentReview: The main QA fixture predates the served-V4 repair and is frozen before R1 execution.
The new QA logic must be authored after the repair but must use independent oracles derived from contract/interface authority, not repair implementation details.
Exact-head CI and deterministic artifact identity are required to prevent local-only or branch-drift false PASS.
rollback: Close the JOB05 R1 PR and delete its branch. PR #411 and repaired product/evidence heads remain unchanged; JOB06 remains frozen.
